target: Raspberry Pi 4B native desktop, PWM1 analog tone output

zstatus prints the Pi audio diagnostic last and unconditionally, including target_pi, so a missing Pi platform flag is visible.
The diagnostic reports initialization stage, beep/tone counters, GPIO mux, clock manager, PWM control, range, and duty registers.
The diagnostic kernel accepts the lowercase paudio command for a direct register snapshot.

not_verified: Physical Pi 4B analog audio output through the 3.5 mm jack.
